# Municipal Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2014

**Kautusang Bayan Blg. 01 — Pagbabawal ng Paghinmol ng Lahat ng Uri ng Sasakyan sa Kalasadang Nasyonal**

Kautusang Bayan Blg. 01

## Summary

Prohibits parking of all types of vehicles on national highway sections within the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], specifically along Manuel Luis, Quezon St., Mabini St., and A. Bonifacio St. Regulates loading and unloading zones at every corner (kanto) for agencies using vehicles for passengers and cargo.

## Key Provisions

- **Parking Prohibition:** All types of vehicles are prohibited from parking on national highway sections within the Pitogo town proper
- **Covered Streets:** Manuel Luis, Quezon St., Mabini St., A. Bonifacio St.
- **Loading/Unloading Zones:** Designated zones at every corner for passenger and cargo loading/unloading
- **Affected Parties:** All agencies and operators using vehicles for passengers and cargo

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]]
- [[Paulino S. Sayat]] — Municipal Mayor
- [[Dexter L. Sayat]] — Vice Mayor / Presiding Officer

## Legal Basis

- [[Sec-16-RA7160]] — General welfare clause
- [[Sec-447-RA7160]] — Powers, duties, functions of the Sangguniang Bayan
